Easy Chicken Pot Pie
By: Timeless Gourmet
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 2:44pm

Ingredients




1 can boned chicken or turkey
1 can mixed vegetables, don't drain
1 can cream of chicken
1 cup Bisquick
1 cup water

Preparation

1 Mix first 3 ingredients and pour into a greased baking dish. Mix Bisquick with water, pour over first mixture and bake in a 400 degree oven for 45 to 50 minutes. (You may use left over chicken or turkey.)
